$comment: Provenance for every clip in this contact sheet. Regenerate any of them with npm run gen:sound-effect -- --input <this file rewritten as a batch> ; the model is eleven_text_to_sound_v2 at mp3_44100_128.

roles.commit: Plays once when the drag is released past the threshold.
roles.cancel: Plays once when the drag is released short of the threshold.
roles.ready: Plays once when the drag crosses the point of no return.
roles.scrub: Long source recording the Scrubbed Tape option moves a playhead through.
roles.stem: Seamless loop a layered option fades in and out by drag distance.
